remarks:
Welcome to the “Lincoln” built by Severyn Development. This plan offers a two story foyer that leads
to an open concept living space. Kitchen with 10 foot island, solid surface counter tops and stainless
steel appliances. The adjacent great room dining space has plenty of room for large gatherings. The first
floor is completed with a laundry room and guest powder room. The second floor has a primary suite
with a “design your bath “ feature which allows you to choose the components you wish including, walk-
in shower, double vanity, soaking tub, single or double walk in closets and double vanity. Two other
bedrooms, full bath and bonus room finish the second floor. The bonus space can accommodate
another bedroom, office, workout room, craft room of home theatre. Enjoy the space of your one acre
lot. In the Williamsville schools district. All Severyn Homes are built to Energy Star standards!  This parcel is part of a bigger parcel that will be subdivided once home is completed- Taxes will be determined once home is complete
